  Dejan Jovanovic and Leonardo de Moura.  Solving Non-Linear Arithmetic.
  In IJCAR 2012, published as LNCS volume 7364, pp. 339--354.

The keymaera family contains VCs from Keymaera verification, see:

  A. Platzer, J.-D. Quesel, and P. Rummer.  Real world verification.
  In CADE 2009, pages 485-501. Springer, 2009.

Submitted by Dejan Jovanovic for SMT-LIB.

verification.method: Compare each complete archive MD5 with the published Zenodo checksum, then compare the SHA-256 of each bundled file with the unmodified archive member. No SMT parsing, rewriting, or solver execution was used.
reproduce: Download the three version-pinned archives from release.archives[].url and verify their published checksums.
For each inputs[] entry, compare sha256sum of path with tar --zstd -xOf <upstream.archive> <upstream.member> | sha256sum.
